title: Copycat Ina Garten Watermelon Cosmo Recipe
description: The Ina Garten Watermelon Cosmo is a cocktail recipe popularized by Ina Garten. This cocktail typically includes fresh watermelon juice, vodka, Cointreau (or another orange liqueur), and freshly squeezed lime juice. It’s known for its refreshing and fruity flavor, perfect for summertime enjoyment.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: Fresh Watermelon Juice: 1 cup (obtained from seedless watermelon)
Vodka: 1/2 cup (Ina often recommends good quality vodka)
Triple Sec or Cointreau: 1/4 cup (for that citrusy sweetness)
Freshly Squeezed Lime Juice: 2 tablespoons (about 1 lime)
instructions:
Prepare Watermelon Juice:

  1. Cut seedless watermelon into chunks and puree in a blender or food processor.
  2. Strain the puree through a fine sieve to collect the juice, pushing through with a spatula to extract as much juice as possible.
  3. You’ll need about 1 cup of juice for the cocktail, so a medium-sized watermelon should suffice.

Mix the Cocktail:

  1. In a cocktail shaker, combine the watermelon juice (1 cup), vodka (1/2 cup), Triple Sec or Cointreau (1/4 cup), and fresh lime juice (2 tablespoons).
  2. Add a generous amount of ice to fill the shaker halfway.

Shake It Up:

  1. Close the lid of the shaker tightly. Shake vigorously for about 30 seconds or until the mixture is well chilled.

Serve:

  1. Strain the cocktail into large martini glasses. Fill them to just below the rim to prevent spills.
  2. Garnish each glass with a wedge or a small triangle of watermelon and, if preferred, a mint leaf for that extra pop of color and freshness.
  3. With garnishes in place, your Watermelon Cosmos are ready to serve. Enjoy the cool, refreshing mix of sweet watermelon and tangy lime with the smooth caress of vodka.
notes:
• Chill Your Glasses: For an added touch of class and to keep your drink colder for longer, chill your martini glasses in the freezer for at least an hour before serving.
  • Choose Quality Ingredients: The better the ingredients, the better the cocktail. Opt for a vodka that you enjoy and a premium Triple Sec or Cointreau for the best taste.
  • Adjust to Taste: If you prefer sweeter cocktails, you might want to add a touch more watermelon juice or a splash of simple syrup. Likewise, for a tangier kick, simply increase the lime juice.
  • Make It Non-Alcoholic: This recipe can easily be adapted for a non-alcoholic version. Just replace the vodka and Triple Sec with sparkling water or a non-alcoholic spirit alternative, adjusting quantities to suit your taste.
